id: title:MarconLP:tell the author when a relabel lands in the cooldown

review.reason: Adds a 10-minute cooldown and helper to remove trigger labels to prevent repeated label-triggered review runs, not a PostHog-specific change.
review.uncertainty: This chunk is not PostHog; it is Stamphog. No PostHog relevance established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires a score, not an observation-only JSON.

observations.behavior: Adds a 10-minute cooldown and a timestamped cache entry, not a boolean, to prevent repeated label-triggered review runs.
observations.posthog_connection: Stamphog review mode uses GitHub trigger labels; this prevents rapid relabels from spamming the LLM backend and keeps the cooldown expiry precise.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to remove the trigger label and post a cooldown notice when a relabel arrives while the cooldown is active.
observations.posthog_connection: Stamphog review mode; this rejects a relabel that arrives before the cooldown expires, removing the label and explaining the wait.
